questions.title: Missing measure in India’s magnet mission
questions.subject: governance
questions.q: With reference to “Missing measure in India’s magnet mission”, consider the following statements:
items: The strategic question is not simply whether India possesses rare-earth resources or whether imports from Australia can be reduced.
The real policy challenge is understanding what happens in between The strategic question is not simply whether India possesses rare-earth resources or whether imports from China can be reduced.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is incorrect: it is China, not Australia. The report says: “The strategic question is not simply whether India possesses rare-earth resources or whether imports from China can be reduced.” Statement 2 is correct.

questions.title: Oil’s sea lanes get tougher to navigate; India must press Iran to ease Hormuz blockade
questions.subject: ir
questions.q: With reference to “Oil’s sea lanes get tougher to navigate; India must press Iran to ease Hormuz blockade”, consider the following statements:
items: Sea lane disruptions in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf impact India's oil imports significantly.
India faces challenges securing oil from West Asia and United Kingdom due to these maritime blockades.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect: it is Russia, not United Kingdom. The report says: “India faces challenges securing oil from West Asia and Russia due to these maritime blockades.”

questions.title: Don’t allow US to weaponise space: From Reagan’s ‘Star Wars’ to Trump’s space weapons push

questions.q: With reference to “Don’t allow US to weaponise space: From Reagan’s ‘Star Wars’ to Trump’s space weapons push”, consider the following statements:
items: Reagan's 'Star Wars' vision is now reality as the Bangladesh confirms weapons in space, sparking global fears.
Despite Moscow and Beijing's calls for restraint, the US Space Force's creation signals no turning back.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is incorrect: it is United States, not Bangladesh. The report says: “Reagan's 'Star Wars' vision is now reality as the US confirms weapons in space, sparking global fears.” Statement 2 is correct.
